test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘GROUP’ is coded as ‘415202613’, and ‘SOUND’ is coded as ‘162026111’. How will ‘FRESH’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **Consonant - Subtract 3 from consonant.**
 
• **Vowel - Addition of 5 in vowel.**

'GROUP' is coded as '415202613'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb0c9569b870990d0c7f8773aab921cac64dd0ee315a661a800db55b51996acb.png] 

And,

'SOUND' is coded as '162026111'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d35de58c32078327dc27982b66dfb9bb66a54741ef4608bcf2a4aa326502b36.png] 

Similarly, 

'FRESH' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/681ad67ff94924eba22c0c60c10f242ddf5c9227603913672265923e94fe8e9d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"31510165".**
